        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;         "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\nexport default async function Page() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to protected page if already logged in\n  if (data?.claims) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;LoginForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!(await hasEmailIdentity(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

{\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt;         },
        "contents": "/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */\nexport function redirectWithCookies(\n  url: URL,\n  supabaseResponse: NextResponse,\n): NextResponse {\n  const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  const setCookieHeaders = supabaseResponse.headers.getSetCookie();\n  setCookieHeaders.forEach((cookieHeader) =&gt; {\n    redirectResponse.headers.append(\"Set-Cookie\", cookieHeader);\n  });\n  return redirectResponse;\n}",

        },
        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request), supabaseResponse);\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96;                   "lineNumber": 1355,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \\\"next/server\\\";\\nimport { type EmailOtpType } from \\\"@supabase/supabase-js\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\\n */\\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\\\"token_hash\\\");\\n  const type = searchParams.get(\\\"type\\\") as EmailOtpType | null;\\n\\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\\n    request,\\n  });\\n\\n  if (token_hash &amp;amp;&amp;amp; type) {\\n    const supabase = createServerClient(\\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\\n      {\\n        cookies: {\\n          getAll() {\\n            return request.cookies.getAll();\\n          },\\n          setAll(cookiesToSet) {\\n            cookiesToSet.fo [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 1562,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 2586,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\\n\\n\\n  // Check for email identity verification first if user is authenticated\\n  // This check runs for protected routes and pending-approval route\\n  // Skip this check only for verify-email route and other auth routes\\n  if (user &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !isVerifyEmailRoute &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (!isPublicRoute || isPendingApprovalRoute)) {\\n    // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n    if (authUser) {\\n      const identities = authUser.identities || [];\\n      const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\\n        (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\\n      if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\\n        url.pathname = \\\"/auth/verify-email\\\";\\n        return NextResponse.redirect(url);\\n      }\\n    } [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \\\"@/lib/auth-helpers\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Pending approval page\\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\\n */\\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\\n\\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\\n  if (!data?.claims) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/auth/login\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile();\\n  if (hasProfile) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/protected\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full max-w-md\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex flex-col gap-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex flex-col gap-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-2xl font-bold\\\"&amp;gt;Pendi [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 3032,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 4387,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \\\"@/components/verify-email-form\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Email verification page\\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\\n */\\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\\n\\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\\n  if (!data?.claims) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/auth/login\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full max-w-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;VerifyEmailForm /&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 4504,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\\n\\n\\n  // Check for email identity verification first if user is authenticated\\n  // This check runs for protected routes and pending-approval route\\n  // Skip this check only for verify-email route and other auth routes\\n  if (user &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !isVerifyEmailRoute &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (!isPublicRoute || isPendingApprovalRoute)) {\\n    // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n    if (authUser) {\\n      const identities = authUser.identities || [];\\n      const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\\n        (identity) =&amp;gt; identity.provider === \\\"email\\\"\\n      );\\n\\n      // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\\n      if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\\n        url.pathname = \\\"/auth/verify-email\\\";\\n        return NextResponse.redirect(url);\\n      }\\n    } [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 18314,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { type NextRequest } from \\\"next/server\\\";\\n\\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \\\"@/lib/auth-helpers\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\\n */\\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\\n  const code = searchParams.get(\\\"code\\\");\\n  const next = searchParams.get(\\\"next\\\");\\n\\n  if (code) {\\n    const supabase = await createClient();\\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\\n\\n    if (!error) {\\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\\n      const redirectTo = next || (hasEmail ? \\\"/protected\\\" : \\\"/auth/verify-email\\\");\\n      redirect(redirectTo);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\\n  redirect(&amp;#96;/auth [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 19627,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 19924,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \\\"@/lib/auth-helpers\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Pending approval page\\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\\n */\\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\\n\\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\\n  if (!data?.claims) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/auth/login\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile();\\n  if (hasProfile) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/protected\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full max-w-md\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex flex-col gap-6\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex flex-col gap-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;h1 className=\\\"text-2xl font-bold\\\"&amp;gt;Pendi [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 24968,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 901,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { redirect } from \\\"next/navigation\\\";\\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \\\"@/components/verify-email-form\\\";\\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \\\"@/lib/auth-helpers\\\";\\n\\n/**\\n * Email verification page\\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\\n */\\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\\n\\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\\n  if (!data?.claims) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/auth/login\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\\n  if (hasEmail) {\\n    redirect(\\\"/protected\\\");\\n  }\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full max-w-sm\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;VerifyEmailForm /&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 10326,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 22728,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

Linter errors are resolved. Summary of changes:

## Summary

Implemented the `next` parameter across the authentication flow. Changes:

### 1. **Middleware/Proxy** (`lib/supabase/proxy.ts`)
   - Includes `next` when redirecting unauthenticated users to login
   - Includes `next` when redirecting users without email identity to verify-email

### 2. **Login Page** (`app/auth/login/page.tsx`)
   - Reads `next` from search params and passes it to `LoginForm`

### 3. **LoginForm Component** (`components/login-form.tsx`)
   - Accepts `next` prop and passes it to `GoogleLoginButton`

### 4. **GoogleLoginButton Component** (`components/google-login-button.tsx`)
   - Accepts `next` prop and includes it in the OAuth callback URL

### 5. **Callback Route** (`app/auth/callback/route.ts`)
   - Preserves `next` when redirecting to verify-email page
   - Uses `next` for final redirect after successful authentication

### 6. **Verify Email Page** (`app/auth/verify-email/page.tsx`)
   - Reads `next` from search params and passes it to `VerifyEmailForm`

### 7. **VerifyEmailForm Component** (`components/verify-email-form.tsx`)
   - Accepts `next` prop and uses it when redirecting after successful email verification

### 8. **Confirm Email Change Route** (`app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts`)
   - Reads `next` parameter and uses it for redirect after email change confirmation

### 9. **Auth Helpers** (`lib/auth-helpers.ts`)
   - Updated `createSuccessUrl` to accept and validate `next` parameter
   - Uses `validateRedirectUrl` to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities

The `next` parameter is now preserved throughout the authentication flow:
- When users are redirected to login from protected routes
- Through the OAuth flow
- When verifying email
- After successful authentication

All redirects use `validateRedirectUrl` to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities.
